model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата е озаглавена "Hidden State Mean" и илюстрира промените в абсолютната средна стойност на скритото състояние през различните слоеве на модел, като представя три отделни линии. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean" и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 4.5, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 1 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4).

Първата линия, представена в син цвят с пунктиран стил (dashed), е обозначена като "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Тя започва при стойност около 0.05 при слой 0, нараства леко до приблизително 0.25–0.30 около слоеве 3–5 и остава относително стабилна в диапазона 0.20–0.40 между слоеве 5 и 15. След слой 15 линията започва постепенно да нараства, достигайки около 0.9 при слой 20, след което рязко се покачва до връх от приблизително 4.3 около слой 22, последван от лек спад до около 2.5 при слой 23.

Втората линия, представена в оранжев/червен цвят с точков (dotted) стил, е обозначена като "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Тя остава много близо до нулата през целия диапазон на оста X, от слой 0 до слой 23, без видими значителни отклонения.

Третата линия, представена в зелен цвят с плътен (solid) стил, е обозначена като "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Подобно на втората линия, тя също остава много близо до нулата през целия диапазон от слой 0 до слой 23, без забележими върхове или спадове.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across network layers for three different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with major tick marks at intervals of 1.0. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style, represents "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; it starts near 0.1 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.25 by layer 3, remains relatively flat between approximately 0.2 and 0.3 through layers 3 to 10, increases gradually to around 0.4 by layer 15, then rises more steeply to approximately 0.9 near layer 20, before sharply spiking upward to around 4.3 at layer 21 and ending near 2.5 at layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; it remains very close to 0 across all layers, staying nearly flat and barely distinguishable from the baseline throughout the entire range. The third line, shown in green with a solid line style, represents "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; it similarly stays very close to 0 across all layers, running nearly flat along the bottom of the plot from layer 0 through layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot illustrates the hidden state mean across layers of a model, comparing values before a gate, after a gate, and for a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 1.0.

The blue dashed line represents the hidden state mean before the gate, with a reported average of 0.71. It starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises to approximately 0.25 by layer 3, and remains relatively steady between 0.2 and 0.4 through layers 3 to 15. It then begins increasing more noticeably, reaching approximately 0.9 around layer 20, before sharply rising to approximately 4.3 at layer 21 and then dropping slightly to around 2.5 at layer 23. The orange dotted line represents the hidden state mean after the gate, with a reported average of 0.05. It remains very close to 0 across all layers, staying below approximately 0.1 throughout the entire range. The green solid line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline, with a reported average of 0.04. It also remains very close to 0 across all layers, largely overlapping with or running very near the orange dotted line, with values consistently below approximately 0.1.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm mit dem Titel „Hidden State Mean" stellt die absolute Mittelwerte der verborgenen Zustände über die Schichten eines Modells für drei verschiedene Bedingungen dar. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 und 4.0. Die erste Linie, dargestellt als blaue gestrichelte Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean before gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,71; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe 0,05, steigt leicht auf etwa 0,25 bei Layer 3–5, verbleibt relativ stabil zwischen 0,2 und 0,4 bis Layer 15, steigt dann allmählich auf etwa 0,9 bei Layer 20 an und zeigt danach einen steilen Anstieg auf etwa 4,3 bei Layer 22, gefolgt von einem leichten Rückgang auf etwa 2,5 bei Layer 23. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt als orange gepunktete Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean after gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,05; sie verläuft nahezu konstant nahe 0 über alle Schichten hinweg, mit nur minimalen Schwankungen, und endet bei Layer 23 bei einem Wert nahe 0,1. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt als grüne durchgezogene Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean of baseline" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,04; sie verläuft ebenfalls nahezu konstant nahe 0 über den gesamten Bereich der x-Achse und bleibt durchgehend auf einem sehr niedrigen Niveau nahe 0.
